description: Header file for the map_adjuster module, which implements auto-tuning core algorithms related to adjusting map-based parameters such as AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio). It declares initialization, adjustment, addition, and retrieval functions relevant to map adjustment algorithms.

methods.name: runMapAdjustments
methods.description: Performs map adjustments, invoking a callback with the adjustment results.

methods.name: addAfr
methods.description: Adds an AFR value associated with RPM and a key.

methods.name: getMultiplier
methods.description: Retrieves the adjustment multiplier for a given RPM and key.
